4.7 Distribution of Mean Temperature by Region

library(ggplot2)
Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.4.3
library(readr)
Warning: package 'readr' was built under R version 4.4.3
library(dplyr)
Warning: package 'dplyr' was built under R version 4.4.3

Attaching package: 'dplyr'
The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':

    filter, lag
The following objects are masked from 'package:base':

    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
# Load data
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data_cleaned.csv")
Rows: 30532 Columns: 9
── Column specification ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Delimiter: ","
chr  (2): Region, Station
dbl  (6): Daily Rainfall Total (mm), Mean Temperature (°C), Maximum Temperat...
date (1): Date

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
# Convert Date to date format and extract Year/Month
weather$Date <- lubridate::ymd(weather$Date)
weather$Year <- lubridate::year(weather$Date)
weather$Month <- lubridate::month(weather$Date)

# Boxplot: Mean Temperature by Region
p <- ggplot(weather, aes(x = Region, y = `Mean Temperature (°C)`)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", color = "darkblue", outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Mean Temperature by Region",
       x = "Region",
       y = "Mean Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plotly::ggplotly(p)

4.8 Yearly Rainfall Trend across All Stations

# Summarize total rainfall per year
yearly_rainfall <- weather %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(total_rainfall = sum(`Daily Rainfall Total (mm)`, na.rm = TRUE))

# Line plot
p <- ggplot(yearly_rainfall, aes(x = Year, y = total_rainfall)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(color = "darkblue", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Total Rainfall per Year across All Stations",
       x = "Year", y = "Total Rainfall (mm)") +
  theme_minimal()
Warning: Using `size` aesthetic for lines was deprecated in ggplot2 3.4.0.
ℹ Please use `linewidth` instead.
plotly::ggplotly(p)

4.9 Monthly Temperature Heatmap per Station

# Average temperature by station and month
monthly_temp <- weather %>%
  group_by(Station, Month) %>%
  summarise(avg_temp = mean(`Mean Temperature (°C)`, na.rm = TRUE))
`summarise()` has grouped output by 'Station'. You can override using the
`.groups` argument.
# Heatmap
p <- ggplot(monthly_temp, aes(x = factor(Month), y = Station, fill = avg_temp)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkred") +
  labs(title = "Average Monthly Mean Temperature by Station",
       x = "Month", y = "Station", fill = "Avg Temp (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()

plotly::ggplotly(p)

4.10 Violin Plot of Mean Temperature Across Years (All Stations)

``{r} # Violin plot for all stations grouped by year p <- ggplot(weather, aes(x = factor(Year), y =Mean Temperature (°C)`)) + geom_violin(fill = “lightblue”, color = “darkblue”) + geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA) + labs(title = “Mean Temperature Distribution Across Years (All Stations)”, x = “Year”, y = “Mean Temperature (°C)”) + theme_minimal()

plotly::ggplotly(p)
